title: docs(pm-skill): fix the hotcrm lane's changeset falsehood, add three measured dispatch readings
body:
Fixes #11499

Four measured lessons from two days of seat operation land in the `pm-dispatch`
references: one factual correction and three readings that were being carried in
the operator's head instead of in the versioned text.

## Authorization

Maintainer, in-session 2026-08-24, verbatim and untranslated:

> 「经验是不是应该写入项目 skills」 → 「写入」

Governed face: this PR stays a **draft** and is merged by the maintainer. Sibling
card #11498 owns `SKILL.md` and is in flight in parallel — this PR does not touch
that file; where a cross-reference was useful it names the section
(「多仓协调(五条规则)」) rather than editing it.

## 1. `references/lanes/hotcrm.md` — the changeset sentence was false

The charter said 「该仓无 changeset 流、无发版板(除非另裁)」. Verified against
`objectstack-ai/hotcrm` at `origin/main` before rewording; **only the false half
moved**:

| claim | verdict | evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| no changeset flow | **false** | `.changeset/` exists; `changeset-check.yml` runs on `pull_request` to `main`/`develop` and fails when the PR adds no `.changeset/*.md` |
| gate is escapable | true, two ways | job is skipped when the PR carries `skip-changeset` (declared in `.github/labels.yml`); an empty-frontmatter changeset also satisfies the added-file count, per the workflow's own comment |
| gate keys on publish status | **false** | hotcrm's `package.json` is `private: true` and every PR is still gated — the opposite of this repo's "judge by the package's publish status" clause, which is why the boundary is spelled out in the lane text |
| no release board | **true, kept** | `.github/labels.yml` declares no `target:*` family; release is a `changeset version` commit plus a `v*.*.*` tag |
| 292 changesets consumed into 3.0.0 | 291, on 2026-08-23 | `chore(release): 3.0.0` deletes 291 `.changeset/*.md` (the 292nd file was `README.md`); tag `v3.0.0` dated 2026-08-23 |

The lane text now carries the corrected mechanism, the failure mode it caused (a
dispatch inheriting the old sentence produces a PR that is red on arrival), and
the still-true half marked as verified rather than merely repeated.

Added alongside it, because it is the premise the sibling card's unlock rule
rests on: hotcrm depends on **published** `@objectstack/*` packages at pinned
versions (measured: all eleven runtime deps pinned to `17.1.0`), not a git pin —
so an upstream fix reaches the exemplar only after it is published and the pin is
bumped, which makes "published", not "merged", the unlock condition for a
cross-repo card.

## 2–3. `references/dispatch-runbook.md` — two zone-discipline clauses

Both land in 「派发词构造细则」, adjacent, right after the three-zone clause they
qualify:

- **Liveness-ledger-first.** A dispatch premise of the form "spec has this slot"
  is a mechanism assumption until the installed ledger row is read. Failure mode
  in the text: metadata that parses, validates, loads — and renders nothing. A
  green receipt on a fake fix, against the cost of one file read.
- **Sibling estimates belong in zone 2.** A cost/shape estimate from another
  dev's report is quoted into the mechanism-assumption zone with a re-measure
  instruction, never dressed as a ruling. The measured failure is in the clause.

## 4. `references/platform-readings.md` — three entries in the facts table

Written in the file's own entry format, and split by evidence class, because the
zone-2 instruction asked for the transport claims to be checked rather than
enshrined:

- **Measured here, 2026-08-24**, GraphQL `remaining: 0` against REST core
  `remaining: 4987` in the same minute: `gh issue view`, `gh pr list` and
  `gh pr checks` all returned `GraphQL: API rate limit already exceeded`
  (`GH_DEBUG=api` confirms `POST /graphql`), while the same facts read fine over
  `gh api` — issue body, `issues/{n}/labels`, `commits/{sha}/check-runs`, and the
  `pulls` list. So a quota-dead hour still runs the whole claim/label/comment/
  review cycle. Confirmed again while opening this PR: `gh pr create` is GraphQL
  and was refused, and this draft was then opened over REST with
  `gh api -X POST repos/{o}/{r}/pulls -F draft=true` in the same minute — so
  delivery itself does not have to wait for a reset.
- **Checked against the REST docs, not called** (and the entry says so): the
  merge itself has a REST route, `PUT /repos/{o}/{r}/pulls/{n}/merge`; the draft
  flip and the issue transfer do not — "Update a pull request" accepts only
  `title`, `body`, `state`, `base`, `maintainer_can_modify`, and the Issues
  endpoint table has no transfer route. Auto-merge arming has no REST endpoint
  either, which is what makes a merge-queue repo the one with no fallback in a
  red window. The claim in the card that `pr merge` is simply GraphQL-only did
  **not** survive that check and is not what the entry says.
- The transfer entry points at the rebuild-at-destination recipe the main file
  already carries, and states why it is quota-immune (REST only).

The pool-sharing half of lesson 4 is deliberately **not** added: the table
already carries a measured entry on quota accounting, and re-stating it would
have produced a second, weaker opinion next to it.

## Paying for the lines: all three files were at ceiling, headroom 0

`check:pm-skill-ratchet` holds these three files at 242 / 134 / 45 lines, each at
**headroom 0**, and raising a ceiling needs its own maintainer ruling. Nothing
was raised. Every added line is paid for in place, as the ratchet's own header
prescribes:

- `lanes/hotcrm.md` — four bullets re-wrapped from ~78 to the 157-column band the
  file (and every sibling lane charter) already uses on its standing-commitment
  line.
- `dispatch-runbook.md` — 「派发词构造细则」 re-wrapped to ~110 columns, 44 lines
  to 39; the file's previous maximum was 105 and the sibling
  `seat-post-protocol.md` carries 126.
- `platform-readings.md` — one four-line bullet joined into a single entry line
  (507 columns, against the file's existing 1052 maximum), which is that file's
  dominant entry shape anyway.

**The re-wraps are provably lossless.** Stripping all whitespace from each file
before and after, then taking the longest common prefix and suffix, the entire
substantive delta is:

- `dispatch-runbook.md` — removed: *(nothing)*; added: the two clauses.
- `platform-readings.md` — removed: *(nothing)*; added: the three entries.
- `lanes/hotcrm.md` — removed: exactly 「该仓无 changeset 流、无发版板(除非另裁);」;
  added: the corrected text.

## Verification

Gate family derived from the diff, not recalled:
`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` → 6
families. Union re-run **after** the final commit, at `c3d115d7a`:

| gate | exit | verdict line |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `check:nul-bytes` | 0 | `check-nul-bytes: OK (scanned 6455 text file(s) ... no raw ASCII control bytes).` |
| `check:doc-authoring` | 0 | `✓ doc authoring guard: 389 files clean — no bare metadata literals.` |
| `check:skill-frame-sync` | 0 | `✓ check-skill-frame-sync: 4 copies of the decision frame are structurally isomorphic across 3 files` |
| `check:pm-skill-ratchet` | 0 | `✓ ... dispatch-runbook.md is 242 lines (ceiling 242; headroom 0).` · `... platform-readings.md is 134 lines (ceiling 134; headroom 0).` · `... lanes/hotcrm.md is 45 lines (ceiling 45; headroom 0).` |
| `check:pm-skill-id-lint` | 0 | `✓ check-skill-id-lint: 21 file(s) clean (pattern /#[0-9]{3,}/g).` |
| `check:pm-governed-merges` | 0 | `✓ check-governed-merges --self-test: 129 assertions ...` |

Exit codes captured before any pipe (`cmd > file 2>&1; EXIT=$?`), and each row
quotes the gate's own verdict line.

**One derived gate was narrowed, declared here rather than silently skipped:**
`check:doc-formula-expressions` needs a full workspace install plus a built
`@objectstack/formula` to run, and its population in this diff is empty by
construction — the gate reads **TS/TSX fenced blocks only** (its own docblock:
"Only TS/TSX fenced blocks"), and all three files contain zero fenced blocks
(`grep -c` for a fence opener: 0, 0, 0). The diff touches neither the gate nor
the formula package, so no untouched file's verdict can move either. CI runs it
regardless.

## Changeset

`.claude/`-only diff, publishes nothing → the `skip-changeset` label is this
repository's declared mechanism and is applied to this PR (added through the
additive labels endpoint, then read back).
